fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-05-10 at about 19:55, it was reported that goods worth about Rs. 85,000 (cosmetic products) were found missing from Thendral Mobiles, a shop near Anbu Park Main Street. Padmini Sri approached Trichy Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000119. The complainant is associated with the business Thendral Mobiles. The complaint mentions Nithin Velan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000004, in connection with the events. Siva Sekar (9000000284) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned photographs and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00360, as the mobile number 9000000004 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, mobile number, witness, suspect, photograph, main street, CCTV
